key_insight: Semifactual prompt stability can be used to assign finer-grained credit in RLVR, reducing spurious token dependence and improving reasoning accuracy without changing model weights.
engineering_relevance: SCAPO offers a practical training signal for LLM alignment pipelines that may improve generalization on math and out-of-distribution tasks with minimal architectural change.
method: Measure token probability drift under semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the problem and answer.
Normalize stability scores to downweight unstable tokens during early policy optimization.
Use these stability-based credits within GRPO-style training without granting extra reward for stability alone.
evidence_signal: On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improved AIME 2024-2026 accuracy by 5.63 and 4.17 points over GRPO and achieved the best results on most math and all OOD benchmarks among compared methods.
watch_item: Stability-based credit assignment depends on how semifactual interventions are defined and may be sensitive to early-training heuristics or prompt perturbation design.
